title: pvHyperTreeGridRandom
body:
## pvHyperTreeGridRandom

Builds a hyper tree grid (vtkHyperTreeGrid) with pseudo-random binary refinement: each node is split with probability SplitFraction down to MaxDepth, a target MaskedFraction of cells is masked, and the root grid spans OutputBounds. A "Depth" cell array records each cell's level. The same Seed reproduces the same tree. Use it to stress-test hyper-tree-grid filters; use pvHyperTreeGrid for an exactly specified tree.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Cell counts grow quickly with MaxDepth and SplitFraction; start with small values.
- Schemaxis generates this source from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for it, so inspect the output before relying on it.

Native constructor: `HyperTreeGridRandom`. Identity: `sources/RandomHyperTreeGridSource`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Dimensions` | Grid size as [nx, ny, nz]. VTK's vtkRandomHyperTreeGridSource interprets these as numbers of points per axis, so there are (n - 1) root trees along each axis: the default [6, 6, 3] gives 5 × 5 × 2 roots. The native documentation's "number of root cells" wording is off by one. | `{"items":{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `MaskedFraction` | The total fraction of cell volume to be masked during construction. This is a target value and the actual fraction of masked volume can vary depending on number of tree and children. | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `MaxDepth` | The value of this property specifies the maximum number of levels in the hyper tree grid. | `{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `OutputBounds` | The bounds of the resulting dataset. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":6,"minItems":6,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1,1,1,1]` |
| `Seed` | Seed of the pseudo-random generator that decides which nodes are split and masked (tree i uses Seed + i). Keeping it fixed reproduces the same grid; changing it gives a different random tree with similar statistics. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `SplitFraction` | The chance that a given node will be split during construction. Higher values mean more splits. | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
